name: Jan Novák
bio:
Jan's passion for motorsport ignited during his childhood, attending local rally events with his father. He pursued a degree in Public Relations, focusing on sports marketing. After graduating, Jan secured an internship at a smaller racing team, quickly proving his ability to manage media relations and craft compelling narratives. His experience there included successfully navigating a minor sponsorship scandal, showcasing his quick thinking and communication skills.

He joined AF Corse with the aim of elevating the team's public image and securing lucrative sponsorship deals. Jan believes in building strong relationships with journalists and influencers, ensuring positive coverage. He is known for his proactive approach, consistently seeking innovative ways to engage fans and promote the team's drivers. He's driven to see AF Corse become a household name in motorsport, known as much for its professionalism as for its success on the track.

Jan's determination and calculated approach make him a valuable asset to any team, even if his preference for working alone can sometimes lead to missed collaborative opportunities. He is confident in his abilities and always strives for perfection, often pushing himself and those around him to achieve more.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: Jan is a slender man with sharp features and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down ideas, even during meetings.
Has a habit of tapping his pen when thinking deeply.
Prefers working late at night, claiming it's when he's most productive.
